% Pattern: env/newenvironment. An environment whose begin code steps a counter
% and writes the head with the number first, as "2.1. Lemma.". Seen in the
% gold pilot (set E).
% want lem-1 statement/lemma 1
% want pf-1 proof - proves=lem-1
\documentclass{article}
\newcounter{item}[section]
\newenvironment{lem}{
\refstepcounter{item}
\par\addvspace{\bigskipamount}
\indent {\bf \theitem.\hspace{1em}Lemma.\,\ }  \sl }
{\par\addvspace{\bigskipamount}
}
\newenvironment{pf}{
\par\addvspace{-\smallskipamount}
\indent {\bf Proof.}$\,\ $ } { $\Box$
\par\addvspace{\bigskipamount}
}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{lem}{} \label{one}
Every compact space is bounded.
\end{lem}
\begin{pf}
Cover the space by balls.
\end{pf}
\end{document}
